title: A firewall profile is disabled by policy

report.title: {Items.Count} firewall {Plural(Items.Count, 'policy disables', 'policies disable')} a network profile

messages.businessImpact: Policy is actively turning the firewall off, most often on the public profile, which is the network where it matters most.
remediation: Enable the firewall on all three profiles and solve the original problem with a rule rather than by disabling it.
